# WEBUILDPRO India

> WEBUILDPRO is an engineering project, internship and industrial prototyping centre in Bangalore (Peenya 2nd Stage, Bengaluru 560058, Karnataka). We build final year projects, IEEE projects, mini projects, custom drones and industrial prototypes for CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical and Civil students — designed, built and tested in our own lab, delivered online and offline across India.

## Key facts

- Founded 2021; 300+ projects delivered with a 100% on-time record
- Google rating: 4.8 stars (40+ reviews) — https://g.co/kgs/zgjqv4M
- Branches: CSE / ISE / AI-ML / BCA / MCA, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil / Mining
- Project types: final year (IEEE and non-IEEE), mini projects (1st–6th semester, from ₹3,500), internships, industrial prototypes, custom drones
- Typical timelines: academic projects 2–4 weeks; industrial prototypes 4–12 weeks
- Every academic delivery includes: working demo, full source code, circuit diagrams, BOM, report material, PPT support and a viva walkthrough
- Pricing: fixed quote within 24 hours, no obligation
- Delivery modes: offline (Bangalore lab), online (pan-India, hardware couriered), hybrid
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

## Projects by branch

- [CSE / ISE / AI-ML Projects](https://webuildpro.in/projects/cse) — ML, AI, data science, blockchain, IoT, Python, image processing, cybersecurity
- [ECE Projects](https://webuildpro.in/projects/ece) — IoT, embedded systems, robotics, drones, VLSI, biomedical, communication
- [EEE Projects](https://webuildpro.in/projects/eee) — power electronics, PLC automation, EV, solar, motor control
- [Mechanical Projects](https://webuildpro.in/projects/mechanical) — automobile, hydraulics & pneumatics, mechatronics, design & analysis, agricultural, renewable energy
- [Civil Projects](https://webuildpro.in/projects/civil) — structural, transportation, geotechnical, water resources, environmental, construction management
